description: Keel security authority Phase 1 policy rules. The LLM requests; this file plus engine.py decides. Bump ../policy_version.py POLICY_VERSION when this file changes.
notes: SUBMISSION additionally requires non-empty evidence and injection-clean content; otherwise DENY (fail closed).
DESTRUCTIVE is deny_unless_approval: only a valid single-use human approval can permit it; the engine never auto-permits.
Unknown action classes fail closed to require_approval via the classifier, never to allow.
